title: Build a Trading Plan You Can Execute

episodes.title: Freeze the Trading Decision in Advance
episodes.subtitle: A usable plan fixes scope, risk, and review rules before an order exists.

episodes.title: Define a Setup Another Trader Could Reproduce
episodes.subtitle: Separate market context, eligibility conditions, the trigger, and invalidation.

episodes.title: Separate Entry, Exit, and Invalidation
episodes.subtitle: Order mechanics and exit paths belong in the plan before position sizing.

episodes.title: Size the Position, Then Cap the Portfolio
episodes.subtitle: Per-trade risk is only one limit; concentration and aggregate exposure still matter.

episodes.title: Build a Watchlist That Produces Decisions
episodes.subtitle: Keep only researched candidates with a written trigger, invalidation, and expiry.

episodes.title: Turn the Plan Into an Execution Routine
episodes.subtitle: A short pre-order check and post-trade record keep written rules operational.
